easyPrerequisites:
Redshift, Rocketeer Chief does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Redshift.
description:
Activate Redshift by tapping it, adding an amount mana of any color equal to its power that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Redshift by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
